messages:
Aisha Patel (CSM): Hey team — CloudBridge pushed back asking for final DPA attachments + SOC2 evidence bundle. They need a presigned link they can share with their security team. Any blockers?
Tom Nguyen (Solutions Eng): I put together the evidence pack draft, includes data flow diagram, KMS key list, and sample SOC2 artifact. Zipped as `cb-evidence-v1.zip`.
Jared Coleman (CloudBridge): Thanks Aisha/Tom — can you confirm that the zip contains proof of data residency and embeddings retention policy? Our legal needs that specifically called out.
Tom Nguyen (Solutions Eng): Yes — folder `residency/` has the region map and the `embeddings-retention.md` we agreed on. Note: retention policy references our configurable TTLs — might need product to confirm default value.
Aisha Patel (CSM): @Priya can you confirm the DPA counter-sign path and whether we can use a presigned S3 link for evidence delivery? Customer wants 7-day access.
Priya Kapoor (Legal): Presigned S3 is fine for delivery. For counter-signature, we need to route to Sales Ops for signature flow; can we attach a cover note that clarifies this is evidence only not a signed DPA?
Aisha Patel (CSM): Yep — will add cover note. @Tom can you regenerate the zip with a README that lists each artifact and the contact for any follow-ups?
Tom Nguyen (Solutions Eng): On it. Also adding a `screencast` folder with two short videos showing console audit logs + tenant-level keys. Will keep each <2min.
onboarding-bot: Upload complete — `cb-evidence-v1.zip` uploaded to /shared/onboarding/cloudbridge/ and presigned link generated (expires in 7 days).
Aisha Patel (CSM): Sharing the presigned link with Jared now. Jared — once your security team reviews, please mark any missing items here or slot the follow-up 30-min call in my calendar.
Jared Coleman (CloudBridge): Got it — sharing with internal team now. Quick Q: our security team asked if Redwood's SOC2 scope includes dedicated workloads (not just hosted). Can someone confirm scope?
Tom Nguyen (Solutions Eng): Short answer: SOC2 artifacts in the pack are for Redwood Hosted control plane + infra. For Dedicated/private deployments we have separate controls and can provide attestation notes. I'll add a `scope-clarity.md` to the zip.
Priya Kapoor (Legal): Also adding a one-line legal note about BYOK/KMS provenance — clarifies shared responsibility and points to our KMS documentation.
Aisha Patel (CSM): Great — next steps: 1) Tom updates zip + README + scope note (ETA 2 hours). 2) I send presigned link + cover note to Jared. 3) Customer reviews, flags gaps. 4) If gaps -> schedule 30-min follow-up with Solutions + Legal.
Jared Coleman (CloudBridge): Sounds good. Appreciate the fast turnaround. Will report back by EOD with whatever the security team says. :thumbsup:
Tom Nguyen (Solutions Eng): Updated zip uploaded as `cb-evidence-v2.zip` and replaced presigned link. I added `scope-clarity.md` and `README.md`.
Aisha Patel (CSM): Thanks Tom — I sent the new link and cover note. Priya/Tom — please be available around 16:00 PT in case they want a quick sync.
Priya Kapoor (Legal): I can be available. If they ask about retention exceptions, I'll need the exact TTLs for their tenant — Tom please paste the default and max TTLs in thread.
Tom Nguyen (Solutions Eng): Default TTL for embeddings: 90 days; configurable up to 540 days for enterprise. Data residency is per-region pinned at provisioning. Pasting so Priya has it.
Jared Coleman (CloudBridge): Perfect — their first pass flagged nothing major, asked one clarifying question about TTLs which I answered with Tom's numbers. They want the DPA counter-sign process clarified before kickoff.
Aisha Patel (CSM): I'll loop in Sales Ops to start the counter-sign path and confirm timeline. Thanks everyone — marking this thread for follow-up.
Jared Coleman (CloudBridge): Closing loop from our side — will ping if more questions.
